title: 7-Day Fear of Failure Desensitization
description: Procrastination protects you from risking failure. If you never start, you never fail. This program breaks that pattern.
outcomes: Reduce fear of failure through exposure

days.title: Failure Inventory
days.insight: What are you afraid will happen if you fail? List it. Then ask: what's the worst that could actually happen?
days.action: Write down your fear of failure. Then write: 'The worst that could happen is...' Be brutally honest.
days.reflectionQuestion: What's the worst that could happen if I fail?

days.title: The Minimum Viable Failure
days.insight: You don't need to do something big to fail. Do something small and let yourself fail at it.
days.action: Do something today where you intentionally do it poorly. Send a quick email. Make a quick sketch. Ship it.
days.reflectionQuestion: What's the smallest, lowest-stakes thing I can fail at?

days.title: Failure Debrief
days.insight: When you do fail, debrief. What did you learn? How can you do better next time?
days.action: When something doesn't go well, ask: 1) What happened? 2) What did I learn? 3) What will I do differently?
days.reflectionQuestion: What did I learn from this failure?

days.title: The Learning Loop
days.insight: Failure isn't the opposite of success — it's part of it. Every failure gets you closer to success.
days.action: Look at something that didn't go well. What can you learn from it? How can you use this to improve?

days.title: Exposure Therapy
days.insight: Fear shrinks when you expose yourself to it. Do something that makes you uncomfortable today.
days.action: Do something that makes your heart race a little. It can be talking to a stranger, asking a question, trying something new.
days.reflectionQuestion: What made me uncomfortable today? Why?

days.title: The Progress Over Perfect
days.insight: Perfection is the enemy of progress. Done is better than perfect. Ship it.
days.action: Find something that's 'almost done'. Mark it done. Celebrate. Move on.
days.reflectionQuestion: What can I ship today that doesn't need to be perfect?

days.title: The Celebration
days.insight: You've faced your fear of failure. Celebrate your progress.
days.action: Write down three things you did this week that you would have avoided last week. Celebrate your growth.
days.reflectionQuestion: What am I proud of for trying?
